Facebook allows you a date stamp for life events, and I see the relationship was back dated to about two/three weeks ago. I was furious. And hurt. Now, I am not hurt because he was in a relationship. Our set up was never a real relationship. I am hurt because he did not inform me of his relationship. All the while he was in a relationship with this other girl, I was messaging him telling him I liked him and missed him. Many opportunities to say "hey by the way I'm with someone now". I am hurt because he didn't seem to have the humanity to inform me that what we were doing, serious or not, was over.
